catalog.name: rtk-ai/rtk
catalog.description: CLI proxy that reduces LLM token consumption by 60-90% on common dev commands. Single Rust binary, zero dependencies

catalog.name: alexgreensh/token-optimizer
catalog.description: Find the ghost tokens. Fix them. Survive compaction. Avoid context quality decay.

scripts.installed_check: command -v claude >/dev/null 2>&1 && claude plugin list --json 2>/dev/null | grep -Fq 'token-optimizer@alexgreensh-token-optimizer'
install: claude plugin marketplace add alexgreensh/token-optimizer || true
postinstall: echo 'In Claude Code: /plugin → Marketplaces → alexgreensh-token-optimizer → enable auto-update if desired.'
uninstall: claude plugin uninstall token-optimizer@alexgreensh-token-optimizer -y || claude plugin marketplace remove alexgreensh/token-optimizer -y || true
